 Greatswords are a type of two-handed martial melee weapon. The following are some base attributes common to most greatswords, although special or magical variants may be significantly different. For the most common, nonmagical type of this weapon, see Greatsword. Further down below, you can find a list of all greatswords in the game.

Properties

Damage
2d6 (2~12) + Strength modifier ⁠Slashing
Details
 Two-Handed
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Dippable

Actions

If you have proficiency, equip in main hand to gain:

 Pommel Strike ()
Make a non-lethal attack against an enemy and possibly  Daze them. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
 Lacerate ()
Slash at your target's vital points to make it  Bleed. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
 Cleave ()
Swing your weapon in a large arc to attack up to 3 enemies at once. They each take half the damage your weapon usually deals. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
